name: MedSPOT_Bench
description: A medical question-answering benchmark hosted on Hugging Face that evaluates LLMs on clinically oriented prompts. It measures accuracy and correctness of model answers across a variety of medical scenarios, providing reference answers for automated scoring. Designed to test clinical knowledge, reasoning, and safety in medical responses.
reputation: A niche medical benchmark available on Hugging Face; useful for clinical QA evaluation but not yet widely adopted in mainstream leaderboards.
